title: Honker: a Rust SQLite extension that adds Postgres-style NOTIFY and LISTEN

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: SQLite single file magic breaks the moment you need a task Q. Honker is a loadable SQLite extension written in Rust that brings Postgress style notify and listen natively to seeite. Durable pub sub task cues event streams all in your existing database file. Same atomic transaction for business logic and Q tasks. No polling. Singled digit millisecond latency.
